divergence_log: Classical integration baseline: this bridge stack joins solver, rotor, graph, hypergraph, simplicial, persistence, ANN, manifold, clustering, and sklearn metric surfaces on one shared graph-family bank.

clifford.reason: load-bearing rotor coordinates for cycle and star families

cvc5.reason: load-bearing independent SMT cross-check of the same tree-law witness

datasketch.reason: load-bearing MinHash/LSH witness over discretized graph-family descriptors

gudhi.reason: load-bearing Rips reconstruction witness from the carrier coordinates

hdbscan.reason: load-bearing density clustering witness on the manifold embedding

pyg.reason: load-bearing graph tensor surface for dense adjacency and degree signatures

pynndescent.reason: load-bearing approximate nearest-neighbor purity witness over extracted feature vectors

pytorch.reason: load-bearing tensor carrier for coordinates, adjacency aggregation, feature assembly, and collapse blending

sklearn.reason: load-bearing scaling and clustering-quality metrics over the shared embedding

sympy.reason: load-bearing Laplacian spectral-root witness per graph sample

toponetx.reason: load-bearing simplicial incidence witness over the same 1-skeleton

umap.reason: load-bearing manifold embedding witness for the graph-family bank

xgi.reason: load-bearing hypergraph degree and line-graph witness

z3.reason: load-bearing tree-law satisfiability witness over each extracted graph family
